info.title: MCP Server for PowerPoint
info.description: PowerPoint automation for AI assistants - slides, shapes, text, tables, charts, images, notes, layouts, and slide-to-image export for visual verification. Requires PowerPoint to be installed. Only runs on Windows.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for Microsoft PowerPoint automation.

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show version information
Without options, starts the MCP server in stdio mode.
Requirements:
- Windows x64
- Microsoft PowerPoint (desktop) installed
